query.source: Published ordinary eight-game native indexes only; no fixed-lab pooling.
query.selection: Native scrimmage, actual post-audible offCall run => designedRun; actual pass call and raw scramble=true and sacked!=true => scramble. Failed escape sacks audited separately. Two-point and non-scrimmage plays excluded. Native known called intent is richer than observational NFL realized-action classification.
query.penalty: For the verified full-native producer only, optional undefined raw.penalty is omitted by JSON and means no native flagged foul. Object means flagged even when declined; malformed/null penalty or missing raw means unknown. Nullified plays excluded. Engine flags are not complete NFL officiating flags.
query.yards: Primary settled GameLog.yards; retain native raw.offenseYards and flag differences. No terminal coordinate inference or substitution. Rounded-whole-yard sensitivity is separate, never changes saved outcomes.
query.context: Actual nativeInput.state before snap: down, distance, yardline, score, quarter, clock. yardline_100=100-state.yardline and los=10+state.yardline. Preserve firstDownX-los separately, never replace missing state.distance with it.
query.carrier: Exact raw.stats.rusher ID to selected offense team's saved league roster; ambiguity/missing stays unknown. Never infer names, slot or QB from scramble label.
query.unavailable: EPA, NFL positive-EPA success, observed run_location/run_gap, charted box and NFL concepts/fronts remain unavailable. Generated offensive scheme and called defense labels remain engine-only margins; Duo is not renamed MAN.
query.cohort: Same immutable source/rosters/game seeds retained; divergent baseline/candidate play streams are not paired snap trials.
query.standardization: Fixed coarse backoff with minimum NFL support declared before comparison; report common support/excluded engine exposure. Weighted NFL conditional means/rates, not pooled quantiles or an engine EPA model.
query.declarationScope: Existing engine outcome summaries were already viewed. New adapter/query is declared before executing its NFL comparison, not outcome-blind preregistration.
